meta.title: A vendor bids itself after the buyer bid on its behalf: one live bid, at the vendor's price
gaps: Exact price of the live bid cannot be asserted with the available read‑back fields
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid).
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” equals 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “bid count” equals 1.
